Apparent Conflict: 2'F can suppress immune activation in some contexts but not others.
Scientific Resolution: Treat as nucleotide-, position-, strand- and sequence-specific chemistry effect; not a simple contradiction.
Dataset Action: Encode modification by position/base; preserve assay context.

Apparent Conflict: 2'OMe may silence, antagonize, or leave a TLR8 response intact.
Scientific Resolution: 2'OMe is not a single phenotype; receptor and position determine outcome.
Dataset Action: Add receptor-specific agonist/antagonist labels and exact positions.

Apparent Conflict: Methylation suppresses classic CpG ODN activation but can fail or increase activity in LNA gapmers.
Scientific Resolution: Chemical context and sequence architecture change TLR9 recognition; classical CpG rules do not transfer wholesale to modern LNA gapmers.
Dataset Action: Use interaction terms; do not apply a universal rule.

Apparent Conflict: Animal assays can be negative while human cells/volunteers are positive.
Scientific Resolution: Species-specific receptor expression/ligand preference is real biology.
Dataset Action: Species-specific labels; do not pool across species without explicit transfer model.

Apparent Conflict: Same CpG can yield different IFN-α behavior in PBMC versus whole blood.
Scientific Resolution: Plasma proteins, anticoagulants and carrier integrity alter effective exposure.
Dataset Action: Assay system/formulation must be first-class metadata.
